| description = These undead zombies drop the bard planar armor set, [[Imbrued Platemail Armor]]. They seem somewhat high MR.

===Lore===

A scorn banshee (simply one of many names by which such creatures are known, "scorn" merely being representative of a cruel, hateful nature) appears as a ragged, insubstantial version of the deceased bard's living form. Its face is twisted in a terrible, hate-filled sneer, and even while singing it manages to fill the air with horrid shrieks, cackles, and wails.
